args: [ -f "$HOME/.cangjie/envsetup.sh" ] && [ -n "$CLAUDE_ENV_FILE" ] || exit 0; source "$HOME/.cangjie/envsetup.sh" >/dev/null 2>&1; for v in CANGJIE_HOME PATH LD_LIBRARY_PATH DYLD_FALLBACK_LIBRARY_PATH SDKROOT; do if [ -n "${!v+x}" ]; then printf "export %s=%q\n" "$v" "${!v}"; fi; done >> "$CLAUDE_ENV_FILE"
